notes.title: Bug Fixes – April 10, 2025
notes.notes:
We have fixed the following issues:

・On the map screen, if the player gives up on deciphering the ""mysterious letter,"" the spot detail screen may not display correctly.
・Opening the menu while reading a ""note"" can sometimes cause unintended behavior.
・On DAY 4, performing certain actions may cause the background image to not display correctly.

We kindly ask that you update your game data to implement the necessary fixes. 
We truly appreciate your understanding and apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

notes.title: Bug Fixes – April 1, 2025
notes.notes:
We have fixed the following issues:

・The Bad End - "Mission Accomplished" occasionally failed to trigger, even when the necessary conditions were fulfilled.

・In cut-in scenes, the default protagonist image appeared instead of the designated illustration.

・The DAY 7 puzzle did not progress as intended.

・When adjusting the dice roll success rate manually, the display on the button did not consistently reflect the actual success rate.

We kindly ask that you update your game data to implement the necessary fixes. 
We truly appreciate your understanding and apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

notes.title: Complete Edition Update! (2024/12/26)
notes.notes:
We’ve rolled out the Complete Edition Update, packed with new gameplay features and convenient functions! Whether you're a first-time player or someone who's already explored the game, the enhanced "Cthulhu Mythos ADV The Isle Of Ubohoth" experience offers even more thrills. Don’t miss out—dive back in and enjoy!

New Features

▼ Cryptic Notes
Hidden across the island, cryptic notes now challenge your wits. Each one is a riddle—put your creativity and problem-solving skills to the test!

▼ Harasho’s Journal
Decode the cryptic notes to unlock entries from Harasho’s journal. This video streamer recounts spine-chilling tales of the horrors he encountered on the island.

▼ Puzzles
New puzzle challenges have been added to your island explorations.

▼ Success Rate Control
Unlock this feature by reaching any ending other than the Bad Ending. In scenes where dice-roll choices appear, a button will now appear in the bottom-left corner of the screen. Adjust the success rate to 0 for guaranteed failure or 100 for guaranteed success. Comes in handy for completing every scenario!

▼ Enhanced Effects
New effects have been added throughout the game to better reflect the emotions and mental state of the characters.

▼ Other Improvements
Design adjustments have been made to the title screen, window frames, and other visual elements for a more polished experience.

notes.title: Additional Feature Update!
notes.notes:
The following functions have been added in response to many requests.

▼ Skip Function
The "Fast Forward" button at the bottom right of the screen has been updated to a "Skip" button.
Clicking it will now instantly skip to the next choice or the start of the next scene.

▼ Ending List
You can now view a list of all endings.
This can be accessed from the "flag icon" on the title screen.
Once you reach an ending, its thumbnail will change, and the ending name will appear.
*If you've already reached an ending, you'll need to do so again for these updates to take effect.
*We're also considering adjustments, as some bad endings are currently very hard to achieve.

notes.title: July 8, 2024 bug fixed.
notes.notes:
We would like to inform you that the following issues were fixed on July 8, 2024.

Demo-related Issues:
When starting the full version of the game from a demo save file, the following problems occurred:
・HP dropped to 0 on DAY 2.
・SAN points dropped to 0 on DAY 3.

Other Issues:
・Issues with progressing correctly in the Hatsumi route.
・Dice roll success rate not recovering even after fullness was restored.
・UI display and value changes not working correctly in the Yukitsune route battle.

notes.title: Guidelines for streaming of ”Cthulhu Mythos ADV The Isle Of Ubohoth"(6/27)
notes.notes:
Guidelines for streaming of ”Cthulhu Mythos ADV The Isle Of Ubohoth" (6/27)

-The entire game of "Cthulhu Mythos ADV: The Isle Of Ubohoth" can be streamed after launch, but please note that each streamer is only permitted to show one ending.
*The ending will be counted as one ending when the staff roll is played, Bad endings, in which only the end name is displayed, do not count as one ending.

-You may use the monetization functions provided by YouTube and other video distribution platforms.

-The video may be used for commentary, analysis, play-by-play, or any other type of video posting or live-streaming for the enjoyment of the contributor and viewers.

-The video which including the main part of the story, such as event scenes, please include "Spoiler alert" in the video title to clearly indicate that the video contains spoilers so as not to deprive other viewers of the enjoyment of the video. However, we prohibit the following types of videos that contain spoilers. (e.g., videos that summarize only the various endings, videos that introduce only the rewards after the endings, etc.)

-Please include the following information in the summary section of your video or live-streaming:
Product name: Cthulhu Mythos ADV The Isle Of Ubohoth
Steam page: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2701590]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2701590[/url]
”Cthulhu Mythos ADV The Isle Of Ubohoth" Official X: [url=https://x.com/YSKyouki]https://x.com/YSKyouki[/url]

*Guidelines may be updated in the future. Please check the latest guidelines before starting the streaming.
